coverage_note: Medi's lines are missing from 35:37 to 37:12: Amal answers him at 35:57-36:48 ('Before طريق', 'No', 'you said طريق التاني'), but none of his words were transcribed. The 36:30 row uses her timestamp. Long Latin stretches: 13:57-15:21, 21:55-26:02, 29:04-33:16 and 44:30-1:03:08 (mostly meta talk about rules). Echo: Amal's 'Be upset.' at 57:10 and 58:06 = بيبسط; Medi's 'yips it / yipsut' (57:02) = his بيبسط attempt with the letters swapped, which is S4 pronunciation. 'Care about the style' (59:10) is engine noise inside انبسطتي بعطلتك. 06:57 ما خطت: engine for ما خططت with the doubled letter dropped. Amal heard مخطط, so the misunderstanding was a sound-shape issue, not a word slip. He moved from ما بخطط to خططت himself at 08:02, before her 08:04, so no row. Self-fixes left out: 00:46 مع صوت -> بصوت (before her echo at 00:49), 10:09 واحد -> واحدة (before her 10:11), 20:09 حلوة -> حلو (before her 20:11), 18:10 جربت -> جربته, 39:19 بدي -> بدنا. 10:21-10:39 clothes: her chat (bluze ... soda u bantaloan azra2 u kundara soda) does not match the engine's 'بنطلون سودا' / 'نظارات سو...'. The engine probably mangled this stretch, so I wrote no gender row. 33:04-33:16 أواعي إمي and 37:29-37:38 'هذا واحد' were his questions, so no rows. 28:08 هو/هي was also a question. 1:00:15 'kani ishi' = taani ishi (engine).
